blurb:
Experience Redwood Magic & Coastal Charm in Sausalito! 

Embark on an exclusive private tour of Muir Woods and Sausalito, where towering redwoods and breathtaking coastal vistas await! Travel in a luxury SUV or van as you cross the Golden Gate Bridge to explore Muir Woods National Monument. Wander through majestic groves, snap photos of ancient trees, and take a peaceful coffee break.

Next, visit Muir Beach for stunning Pacific views, then cruise along California State Route 1 to Sausalito. Stroll through eclectic shops, admire houseboats, and indulge in delicious waterfront dining.

End your day with a scenic ferry ride back to San Francisco, soaking in the stunning views.

This worry-free tour is the perfect escape into the redwoods and coastal beauty of Sausalito.

Book your adventure today!
